name: Aeroform R9
alt: Pre-owned road bike displayed in a shop
description: A fast, all-round race build with a responsive carbon frame and electronic shifting. Inspected, tuned, and ready for its next season.

inspectionScores.notes: No structural damage observed; alignment is within tolerance.
Wheels run true; tyres show light, even wear.
Chain wear is low; shifts cleanly under load.

Road test passed; serial and included parts recorded.

name: Summit Pro 7
alt: Pre-owned bicycle in a dark showroom

name: Vector TT 8
alt: Pre-owned bicycle displayed on a showroom rack
